units.text: Access to the CBAM Registry for Accredited Verifiers consists of 2 steps:
REQUEST FOR TECHNICAL USER ACCESS
QUICK GUIDE FOR ACCREDITED VERIFIERS ON HOW TO REQUEST TECHNICAL USER ACCESS
REQUEST FOR REGISTRATION AS VERIFIER
EU ACCESS (handled by the Commission)
CBAM Registry 03CI Portal (managed by National Competent Authorities of the EU MSs)
This Quick Guide describes
the first step in the process – technical user access.
For more details on the technical user access, please consult the following document:
CBAM Registry - Guidance on access and registration request procedures for Accredited Verifiers
Identity: this field must display “Request new identity”​
Type of Person: this field must display “Legal Person”​
Legal name: this field must be completed with the Name of the company as it appears in the supporting document (company registration documentation) and in the transliterated internationalised name.​
Type of Actor: this field must display “Accredited Entity Operator”​
Type of Identifier: this field must display "Oganisation ID"
Page to start the access request to EU access .​
If you are not an Accredited Entity (e.g. an accredited verifier for CBAM), your technical user access request will be rejected.
Domain: this field must display “Carbon Boder Adjustment Mechanism”
Subdomain: this field must display “Accredited Entities”
Application: this field must display “CBAM Registry”
First step – Access CBAM Registry – O3CI Portal and login using your EU Login account
Accreditation Country Code: This field is mandatory. Select the country code of the NAB that provided the Accreditation.
Accreditation Number: Enter the accreditation number as provided by NAB.
Company Address: the address of the company must be completed as it appears on the supporting document and using Latin characters.
Company Email: It is recommended to use a corporate email address of the company making the request.

Company Identifier: It is very important that the organization's identification number is entered exactly as it appears on the supporting document (company registration documentation). Otherwise, the application will be rejected.
Company ISO-2 Country Code: this field refers to the company’s country of registration nomenclature according to the ISO standard.
Company Website: this field is not mandatory, but it is a recommendation to facilitate the application.
Both boxes must be checked for the request, except in the case where the Company does not wish to delegate access to an employee, in which case you should only select Admin User.

Attachment - Supporting Document: The supporting documents must be official documents from the country where the company is located (1 and 2) and from the country of the authority which granted accreditation to the verifier (3):
Company registration documentation
Identity document(s) of the person(s) acting on behalf of the accredited entity
Accreditation Certificate
Please, upload one PDF file merging the 3 documents indicated above

Please note that EU access is a first step, whose exclusive purpose is to become a user to get access to the CBAM registry. This step is a prerequisite to request access to the CBAM registry as an accredited verifier.

The second step for you is to request registration as a Registered Accredited Verifier in the CBAM registry. The decision to grant such registration is to be taken by the National Competent Authority of the country of accreditation.
To complete the second step, see the links below:
List of EU NCA authorities
CBAM Registry - Guidance on access and registration request procedures for Accredited Verifiers

PLEASE NOTE THAT TO PROCESS AND ACCEPT YOUR TECHNICAL USER ACCESS REQUEST, IT IS NECESSARY TO COMPLETE ALL THE REQUIRED FIELDS ON THE PREVIOUS PAGES. IF THIS INFORMATION IS NOT PROVIDED, WE WILL BE UNABLE TO VERIFY THE DETAILS, AND THE TECHNICAL USER ACCESS REQUEST WILL BE REJECTED.
